entities.summary: Slaven Letica (b. 1947-06-28, Podgora, Split-Dalmatia County) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Podgora, Split-Dalmatia County and Croatia. Known in the fields of croatia, merchants & economists, europe.
